description: KNa₂Li₃Fe₂(Si₂O₅)₆ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6/mcc space group. K is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 3.07 Å. Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.42 Å. Li is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Li-O bond lengths are 2.00 Å. Fe is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Fe-O bond lengths are 2.04 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.65 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one K and two equivalent Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li, one Fe, and one Si atom.
